card.line: Ashkelon was one of the five Philistine cities, a seaport on the Mediterranean coast, and it is where Samson went after he lost his riddle contest.

moments.title: Samson pays his riddle debt
moments.text: After the men of the city solved his riddle, the Spirit of the LORD came mightily upon Samson. He went down to Ashkelon, killed thirty men, and gave their clothes to those who had solved the riddle.
